Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour

Class WireRules

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour.WireRules
@Internal public final class WireRules extends Object
Behaviour values read from the component data BDS sends (or Paletter sends for custom content): one rule per key. The same rules read vanilla wire data and custom components, so the tests check them against the vanilla dumps on the data driven blocks that carry both. Scalar rules are the inferred rules of data/model/mappings.json read backwards; the shapes are the hand-written ShapeRules.
